maya: quick heads-up — planning a short maintenance for control-plane rack `rack-ctrl-7` on Fri 03:30 UTC (60m nominal). Goal: apply small kernel micro-update + rotate controller leader pins. No GPU compute nodes touched.

maya: Expected: brief control-plane API hiccups (leader election) and increased control-plane RPCs during fallback. Inference serving should be unaffected.

jamie: Suggest cohorts of 1 node (6-node rack) with 8m stagger to minimize election overlap. After each node reboot, run a kv preseed job for 10m.

maya: Agreed. Cohort 1-node cadence. KV preseed 600s after node restarts. Canary after cohort3 for 15m. Abort if >2 leader elections in rolling window or p95 API > 600ms.

liam: I'll run canary and monitor etcd elections. Plan to run synthetic control-plane writes: 50ops/s for 15m. I'll post results 25m before.

ops-bot: Ticket #INC-3402 created and scheduled. Runbook: https://intra.redwood/ops/runbooks/controlplane-maintenance

kevin: Support: status page draft ready. We'll send a 4h pre-alert to customers in affected regions and a short live update during the window. Prepare PSAT.

sasha: Product: confirm no Dedicated pool failovers or model rollouts scheduled. Also check routing policies — ensure compute-plane sticky routing remains.

maya: Confirmed: no rollouts or migrations. Dedicated pools stay local. We'll set `dedicated-safe` flag in ticket.

tony: Note on costs: if we temporarily fallback cross-region, control-plane RPC egress may spike ~30k calls; small billing impact but call out in post-op.

liam: Rollback commands ready: `infra-rollback-controlplane --rack rack-ctrl-7` and revert route-shadow.

jamie: Add `route-shadow --enable` during cohort to detect routing regressions before flipping traffic.

maya: Runbook snippet for ops:
```
infra-cordon --rack rack-ctrl-7 --nodes 1
kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
infra-reboot --soft
kvcache-seed --delay 600
infra-verify-controlplane --checks etcd,api,pods
```

liam: ACK (sre). I'll be on-call and will post the canary link.

tony: ACK (oncall).

kevin: ACK (support).

ops-bot: Ticket #INC-3402 state -> scheduled. Notifying eng-infra-oncall.

maya: Thanks everyone. I'll post a brief post-op summary here within 12h after completion. Ping here if anything changes. :thumbsup:
